meta.description: Convert heterogeneous documents and selected URIs to Markdown with Microsoft MarkItDown for text analysis, search, and LLM/RAG ingestion. Covers safe local conversion, streams, Office/PDF/data formats, batch workflows, plugins, vision OCR, Azure extraction, and the official MCP server.

scientific_integrity.detail: Infrastructure document conversion skill, not research methodology

functional_suitability.note: Perfect coverage: local/stream/response/URI conversion methods, batch workflows, literature conversion, OCR/cloud extraction, MCP server, plugins; comprehensive 6-reference progressive disclosure

reliability.note: Perfect: exact version pin (markitdown==0.1.6), release date (2026-05-26), SHA-256 verification noted, extras documentation, migration guide from 0.0.x

performance_context.note: Excellently organized 265-line SKILL.md with outstanding progressive disclosure through 6 detailed reference files; clear conversion method decision table

agent_usability.note: Perfect trigger description with specific document types and use cases; comprehensive 'Choose the Right Path' decision table; clear scope boundaries with alternative recommendations

human_usability.note: Excellent setup with uv, extras documentation, version verification, installation inspector; clear quick start for CLI and Python with progressive complexity

security.note: Perfect: narrowest method guidance, converted text as untrusted (prompt injection warning), local/external separation, plugins opt-in, network/credential controls documented

maintainability.note: Perfect: version 2.1, exact target version (0.1.6), release date, authoritative sources with URLs, migration guide from older versions, deprecation notes (text_content → markdown)

agent_specific.note: Perfect composability: narrowest-method principle, bundled batch/literature helpers, quality checks documented, MCP server for agent integration, clear trust boundaries

key_strengths: Perfect functional suitability with comprehensive coverage of all conversion methods (local, stream, response, URI), batch/literature workflows, OCR/cloud extraction, plugins, and MCP server
Exceptional security posture: narrowest-method principle, converted text as untrusted with prompt injection warnings, local/external separation, plugins opt-in, network/credential controls
Perfect reliability with exact version pinning (markitdown==0.1.6), release date, migration guide from 0.0.x, deprecation handling (text_content → markdown), and extras documentation
Outstanding agent integration with MCP server (convert_to_markdown tool), bundled batch/literature helpers, narrowest-method composability principle, and clear trust boundaries
Excellent progressive disclosure with 'Choose the Right Path' decision table and 6 detailed reference files covering API, formats, cloud/OCR, MCP/plugins, security, and workflows

recommendations.title: Add performance guidance for large document batches
recommendations.problem: Batch conversion documented but no guidance on memory limits or parallelization
recommendations.root_cause: Agent-specific composability focuses on correctness rather than performance patterns
recommendations.fix: Add to workflows.md: guidance on batch size limits for memory-constrained environments, parallel processing patterns with multiprocessing/concurrent.futures, and progress tracking for large collections

recommendations.title: Add explicit plugin version compatibility matrix
recommendations.problem: markitdown-ocr version listed but compatibility with core 0.1.6 not explicitly stated
recommendations.root_cause: Maintainability focuses on core package versioning rather than plugin ecosystem
recommendations.fix: Add to mcp_and_plugins.md: compatibility matrix showing which plugin versions work with markitdown 0.1.6, with note about testing compatibility before production use

recommendations.title: Add troubleshooting examples for common conversion failures
recommendations.problem: Troubleshooting table present but no concrete examples with solutions
recommendations.root_cause: Focus on issue identification rather than step-by-step resolution examples
recommendations.fix: Expand troubleshooting section with concrete examples: specific error messages, diagnosis steps, and working solutions for common cases like password-protected PDFs, corrupted Office files, or unsupported codecs
